capabilities: Highlight PDF passages in five colors
Collect marked quotes into a per-book Markdown note
Link each quote to its PDF page
Store highlight positions in JSON data files
Translate selected words via Google Translate
extras: Word auto-translation is on by default and sends selections to translate.googleapis.com; it can be disabled so marking, copying and notes work offline. Highlight data lives in JSON files under Sistema/Marcações de PDF/Dados and must be synced together with the PDF and its note; scans need an OCR text layer. GPL-3.0-only.
problem: Obsidian's PDF reader does not keep colored highlights or gather marked quotes into a companion note with page links.

relations.evidence: Ao tocar em Traduzir, o plugin consulta o Google com o texto da seleção

summary: PDF annotation tool that highlights passages in five colors and gathers the quotes, with page links, into a Markdown note beside each PDF.
